Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast arcane illusion spells per the Spells Per Day table, plus Bonus Spells from high Intelligence.

Glamour

  • Effect: A pool of Glamour points equal to your Intelligence modifier + half your Illusionist level (minimum 1), spent on tricks: any feature that costs Glamour.
  • You regain them all on a full rest.
  • You may use one trick on your turn, and Misdirect once a round out of turn.
  • Your illusions are your Illusion spells, your Phantasm and the doubles your tricks make.
  • 9th level: when an encounter begins and your pool is empty, you regain 2 points

Misdirect

  • Effect: Once a round, out of turn, when a creature you can see attacks you, spend 1 Glamour: it makes a Will save against your Class Save DC. On a failure the attack hits an illusory double and misses.

Phantom Wound

  • Effect: As your action, spend 1 Glamour: one creature within 60ft that can see makes a Will save against your Class Save DC or takes 2d6 psychic damage. A creature fooled by one of your illusions saves with Disadvantage.
  • Damage: 3d6 at 5th, 4d6 at 9th, 5d6 at 13th, 6d6 at 17th, 7d6 at 21st

Eye for the False

  • Effect: Advantage on saves against illusions and on checks to see through disguises. Once a round, as no action, you may try to disbelieve an illusion you can see without touching or studying it.

Disguise (Charisma)

  • Effect: Disguise yourself or impersonate others: 1d3×10 minutes for a general disguise, 1 month to copy a specific person; height and weight shift by a tenth at most. The GM rolls secretly; a disguise far from your build, age and ancestry, or a suspicious observer, makes it harder.
  • 10th level: change your appearance at will, as the Change Self spell. Once per day the change also fools touch, smell and True Seeing until you end it

2nd Level

Lingering Illusion

  • Effect: An illusion you maintain by concentration lasts 1 more round after you stop concentrating or are interrupted.
  • 8th level: your Illusion spells that need no concentration last twice as long

3rd Level

Convincing Illusions

  • Effect: A creature makes its first save to disbelieve each of your illusions with Disadvantage. Always on.
  • 5th level: a creature that only studies your illusion gets no save to disbelieve it

Mirage Step

  • Effect: As part of your movement, spend 1 Glamour: swap places with one of your illusions within 30ft. This movement provokes no Attacks of Opportunity.

4th Level

Quickened Illusion

  • Effect: Once per day, cast an Illusion-school spell of 2nd level or lower as part of the same action as another spell.

Drawn Veil

  • Effect: As part of your action, spend 1 Glamour: you or one ally within 30ft is Invisible until the end of its next turn.

5th Level

Phantasm

  • Effect: During a rest, weave an illusory companion of your size or smaller, in any shape.
  • It lasts until destroyed or rewoven, acts on your turn at no cost, moves 30ft (flying, if winged) and cannot attack or move objects.
  • It can Aid an ally against a creature beside it, flank, and scout: as part of your action, see and hear through it within 120ft.
  • One hit or damaging effect destroys it, and a creature that sees through it ignores it.
  • Re-form it beside you, as part of your action, for 1 Glamour.
  • 13th level: only a second hit destroys it

6th Level

See Invisible (Intelligence)

  • Effect: Once a round, as no action, while an invisible creature or object is within 30ft, make an Intelligence check to sense (not see) its location and movement.
  • 18th level: a success also shows its shape and size
  • 24th level: you permanently see all things as the True Seeing spell, with no check

7th Level

Arcane Analysis (Intelligence)

  • Effect: After 5 rounds of study, an Intelligence check reveals whether an item is magical and the origin of its magic (Aldorethi craft, divine creation, alchemy and so on), if you have met that kind of magic before.
  • 18th level: also reveals the item's power and history

Seed of Doubt

  • Effect: As part of your action, spend 1 Glamour: one creature within 60ft makes a Will save against your Class Save DC. On a failure, until the end of its next turn it takes one real creature or object you choose for an illusion: it will not attack or avoid it, and that creature has Advantage on attacks against it.

13th Level

Half-Real

  • Effect: Damage your Illusion spells deal to a creature that believes them is real: it can drop the creature to 0 HP and doesn't fade when the illusion ends, and spells that deal half damage to believers (such as Shadow Monsters) deal full damage. A creature that sees through the illusion takes none.

Shattered Glass

  • Effect: As your action, spend 2 Glamour to shatter one of your illusions within 60ft. Each creature within 10ft of it makes a Will save against your Class Save DC: on a failure it takes your Phantom Wound damage and is Blinded until the end of its next turn; on a success it takes half.

15th Level

  • Intelligence Bonus: permanent +1 Intelligence. It can take the score past 20, to 22 at most (see The Mortal Limit in Character Creation).

18th Level

Displacement

  • Effect: The first attack against you each round has Disadvantage. A creature that can see through illusions (True Seeing, blindsight and similar) ignores it. Always on.

20th Level

Renown: Theatre of Mirrors

  • Effect: You may found a theatre of mirrors (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 1d4 apprentices and a troupe of players join it. While you hold it, from 24th level you may perform your Magnum Opus there once more each month.

24th Level

Magnum Opus

  • Effect: Once per month, a day-long ritual weaving Distort Reality, Permanent Image and Polymorph Any Object together creates any single object, being (of Level up to half yours, with all its powers), or area of 10ft×10ft per level.
  • It cannot be dispelled for 1 day per level, except by a caster of your level or higher.
  • Only one can exist at a time.
  • Each work has a 1% chance per level of becoming permanently real: it can never be dispelled or disbelieved, and no longer counts as your one Magnum Opus

Kits: Arneyan Illusion Traditions

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Illusionist folder. Drag one onto your character.

Illusionist Kits represent the tradition, school, or circumstance that trained the character in the arcane arts of illusion. The peoples, orders and places a kit names are examples, not the only ones: a kit suits anyone from a tradition like it.

Illusionist Spell List

Spells available to the Illusionist, by level. * = reversible spell. ‡ = needs a costed material component (see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue). Full descriptions, saves and components are in Spellcasting in Arneyan.

Spells Per Day

  • Bonus Spells: Intelligence 13–15 grants an extra 1st level spell, 16–17 an extra 2nd level spell, 18+ an extra 3rd level spell. Cumulative, and only acquired once the Illusionist is high enough level to cast that tier.
